title: 86 American Indian or Alaska Native students enrolled in Litchfield Elementary District schools in 2025-26
text:
86 American Indian or Alaska Native students enrolled in Litchfield Elementary District schools in 2025-26
Litchfield Elementary District schools enrolled 86 American Indian or Alaska Native students in the 2025-26 school year, 11.7% more than the previous year, according to the Arizona Department of Education.
Data showed that American Indian or Alaska Native students made up 0.8% of the 10,646 students enrolled in Litchfield Elementary District schools during the 2025-26 school year. They were the second-smallest ethnic group in district schools.
Litchfield Elementary District roughly covers schools within Maricopa County and has a main office in Litchfield Park.
Among the 16 schools in Litchfield Elementary District, Barbara B. Robey Elementary School recorded the highest enrollment of American Indian or Alaska Native students in the 2025-26 school year, with a total of nine students.
Arizona ranks dead last in educational success among U.S. states, according to World Population Review, which graded states based on K–12 performance, funding, higher education, and safety.
Arizona's K-12 enrollment has shifted away from district public schools since the pandemic, according to the Common Sense Institute. The organization reported that public school enrollment peaked in 2019-20 and has since fallen by about 50,000 students, while ESA enrollment has grown and charter school growth has slowed.
| Year | Total District Enrollment | Total American Indian or Alaska Native Students | American Indian or Alaska Native % |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2021 | 10,527 | 82 | 0.8% |
| 2022 | 10,877 | 89 | 0.8% |
| 2023 | 10,855 | 97 | 0.9% |
| 2024 | 10,734 | 89 | 0.8% |
| 2025 | 10,727 | 77 | 0.7% |
| 2026 | 10,646 | 86 | 0.8% |
Information in this article was obtained from the Arizona Department of Education. The source data can be found here.
